en.name: Hannibal
en.ability: You think you are a good character, but you are not. Minions learn 3 bluffs. Each night*, a player might die. The 1st Hannibal to die, becomes good. [+1 Hannibal]

revisions.v1: You think you are a good character, but you are not. Minions learn 3 bluffs. Each night*, a player might die. The 1st Hannibal to die, becomes good. [+1 Hannibal]

en.flavor: "I will either find a way or make one." - Hannibal 247 B.C. - c 182 B.C.
en.firstNightReminder: Select 2 good players and place the IS HANNIBAL reminder tokens. Wake all Minions together, show them the Hannibals and show them three not-in-play character tokens (these must be the same).
en.otherNightReminder: Choose a player, that player dies. If a Hannibal died today, wake that player and show them the 'You are' card, the Hannibal token and then the thumbs up good signal.

zh.name: 汉尼拔
zh.ability: 你以为你是一个善良角色，但其实你不是。爪牙会得知三个伪装。每个夜晚*，可能会有一名玩家死亡。首个死亡的汉尼拔转变为善良阵营。【+1汉尼拔】

revisions.v1: 你以为你是一个善良角色，但其实你不是。爪牙会得知三个伪装。每个夜晚*，可能会有一名玩家死亡。首个死亡的汉尼拔转变为善良阵营。【+1汉尼拔】

zh.flavor: ‘我会找到一条道路或者开辟一条道路。’-汉尼拔 前247-前182
zh.firstNightReminder: 唤醒所有爪牙，向他们展示三个不在场善良角色标记，向他们展示“是汉尼拔”标记，指向两名是汉尼拔的玩家。
zh.otherNightReminder: 每名存活的汉尼拔可能造成一名玩家死亡。如果一名汉尼拔死亡，唤醒该玩家并向他展示“你是”信息标记，汉尼拔角色标记和大拇指向上的手势。
